# AI Act — articles and annexes

<!-- generated by _system/build.py from _sources/ — do not edit; rerun the script -->

Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, consolidated text of 27.07.2026, one file per article or annex, word for word. It includes amendment M1, Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 of 8 July 2026. In the text, `▼B` starts original 2024 wording, `▼M1` starts wording M1 added or replaced, and `▼M1 —————` marks wording M1 deleted. Files marked 2026 below differ from the 2024 text: read them rather than rely on memory.

Path of any article: `ai-act/<chapter folder>/art-NNN.md`, three digits (Art 4a is `art-004a.md`). Annexes: `ai-act/annexes/annex-NN.md`. Sizes are in tokens. Each file ends with links to what it cites, what cites it, and the review areas that use it. Defined terms: `_index/definitions.md`. The AI Act's recitals are not in this library.
